name: Keka
description_en:
Keka is a cloud people platform whose HRIS centers employee data, documents, organization structure and lifecycle workflows. Its wider offering includes payroll, attendance, hiring, performance and project services, with distinct plans and add-ons.

The HRIS page describes employee changes flowing into payroll and reporting, but the pricing page makes multi-entity payroll, APIs and several advanced functions separate purchase items. Buyers should evaluate the exact package rather than treating every platform capability as included.
description_zh:
Keka 是云端人员管理平台，HRIS 集中员工数据、文档、组织结构及生命周期流程。更广产品还包含工资、考勤、招聘、绩效及项目服务，并有不同套餐和附加产品。

HRIS 页描述员工变更进入工资和报表，但价格页把多实体工资、API 及若干高级功能列为独立采购项。买家应评估具体套餐，不能把整个平台的能力都视为已包含。

core_features.name_zh: 含变更历史的员工档案
core_features.explanation_en: The HRIS page describes personal and job records, custom fields, org charts and timestamped changes attributed to users.
core_features.explanation_zh: HRIS 页描述个人任职档案、自定义字段、组织图及带时间和操作人的字段变更记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees access documents and requests, while managers handle routed approvals within HR-defined guardrails.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工访问文档及请求，经理在 HR 定义的边界内处理路由审批。

core_features.explanation_en: Foundation has basic onboarding and roles; Strength adds advanced onboarding and custom privileges; Growth adds event-triggered workflows and performance tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: Foundation 提供基础入职及角色，Strength 增加高级入职和自定义权限，Growth 增加事件触发流程及绩效工具。

pricing.summary_en: Quote required for subscription and add-ons. An explicit setup fee covers onboarding; no numerical rate or trial duration verified in read text.
pricing.summary_zh: 订阅及附加项需报价。官方明确入门有设置费，所读正文未核实数值费率或试用期限。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Verify a change across records and permissions
sections.title_zh: 跨档案与权限核对变更
sections.en: Keka documents a searchable employee record with job history, organization placement, documents and custom fields. It says changes to role, department or location update payroll, organization charts and reporting, and that field changes are timestamped and attributed to a user. An illustrative acceptance case is a manager transfer: inspect the employee record, the new reporting line, the approval recipient and the former manager’s access. These are test recommendations; the claimed propagation and audit detail were not exercised. A shared record still requires correct identifiers, ownership and effective-date rules.
sections.zh: Keka 描述可搜索的员工档案，涵盖任职历史、组织归属、文件及自定义字段，并称岗位、部门和地点变更会更新工资、组织图及报表，字段变更有时间及操作人记录。验收示例可用经理调动：检查员工档案、新汇报关系、审批接收人及原经理权限。这些属于测试建议，尚未实际验证传播和审计细节；共享档案仍需正确编号、责任和生效日期规则。

sections.title_en: Identify the automation tier you need
sections.en: The reviewed HRMS & Payroll plan section lists Foundation, Strength and Growth. Foundation includes basic onboarding with limited tasks, standard access roles, leave, basic shifts, payroll and employee self-service. Strength adds advanced onboarding with Keka Sign and unlimited tasks, custom roles, analytics, geofencing and SSO. Growth adds event-triggered workflows, a custom report builder, headcount planning, goals and performance reviews. Hiring and Projects & Timesheets have their own sections; do not treat their capabilities as HRMS plan entitlements without a quote.
sections.zh: 所读 HRMS 与工资套餐分为 Foundation、Strength、Growth。Foundation 包含任务数受限的基础入职、标准权限、休假、基础班次、工资和员工自助；Strength 增加 Keka Sign、无限入职任务、自定义权限、分析、围栏和 SSO；Growth 增加事件触发流程、自定义报表、人数规划、目标及绩效评估。招聘、项目与工时表有独立章节，未报价前不能将其视为 HRMS 权益。

sections.title_en: Multi-entity and APIs have purchase conditions
sections.title_zh: 多实体与 API 存在采购条件
sections.en: The HRIS page promotes multi-entity and multi-location records, while pricing lists Multiple Legal Entities (Pay Groups) as an add-on. Advanced shift management, APIs and webhooks, helpdesk and several integrations are also in an add-on section. This is a distinction between holding records and licensing all related processing capabilities. Specify entity count, pay groups, interface direction and SSO provider in the proposal. Attendance and payroll examples name Indian reports such as PF, ESI, TDS, Form 16 and Form 24Q; that does not establish equivalent filings in every market.
sections.zh: HRIS 页宣传多实体、多地点档案，而价格页将 Multiple Legal Entities（工资组）列为附加项，高级班次、API 与 webhook、服务台及若干集成也在附加章节。这体现保存记录与许可全部相关处理能力的区别。方案中应写明实体数量、工资组、接口方向和 SSO 提供方。考勤及工资示例提到印度 PF、ESI、TDS、Form 16 和 Form 24Q，不能推定所有市场有等同申报。

sections.title_en: Budget for the disclosed setup fee
sections.en: The read pricing page provides a feature matrix and free-trial invitations, but no numeric subscription rate was available in its visible text. The FAQ explicitly says a setup fee applies for guided payroll configuration, employee import, past-salary validation and customization. It also says salary-structure and compliance-setup guidance can be provided without an additional charge within onboarding; that does not cancel the setup fee. Obtain subscription, add-ons, implementation, tax, contract length and trial terms in writing. No sustained free full HR plan was established.
sections.zh: 所读价格页提供功能对照和免费试用入口，但可见正文没有订阅金额。FAQ 明确说明设置费涵盖工资配置引导、员工导入、历史薪资校验及定制，又称入门过程中的薪资结构和合规设置指导不额外收费，后者不能抵消设置费本身。需书面确认订阅、附加项、实施、税、合同期及试用条件；本次未确立完整 HR 的长期免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Pilot permissions and historical payroll together
sections.title_zh: 同时试运行权限与历史工资
sections.en: Keka is relevant when a growing team needs employee lifecycle data connected with payroll and approvals. Buyers seeking only a basic directory should weigh implementation and module costs. Prepare identifiers, hierarchy, opening balances, historical salary and approvers; then test one rejected request and one retroactive change before replacing existing records. The vendor says its support team needs explicit customer permission to view data, but that control was not tested. Security badges, hosting statements and compliance claims were not independently audited. Complete export, rollback, audit retention, regional coverage and source-code licensing remain unverified.
sections.zh: 成长团队需要把员工生命周期与工资、审批相连时，可以评估 Keka。仅需基础通讯录的买家应衡量实施及模块成本。需准备编号、层级、期初余额、历史工资和审批人，在替换既有档案前测试一次拒批及追溯修改。供应商称支持团队查看数据需客户明确授权，本研究未测试该控制，也未独立审计安全标志、托管声明及合规说法。完整导出、回退、审计保留、地区覆盖及源代码许可仍未核实。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
